2607.15901.title: DSWorld: A Data Science World Model for Efficient Autonomous Agents
2607.15901.paper_summary: Despite strong capabilities in data understanding and decision-making, autonomous data science agents still heavily rely on trial-and-error workflows that involve expensive computation. This bottleneck motivates models that can anticipate the effects of data science operations before real execution. In this paper, we introduce the concept of Data Science World Model, which model the data science execution environment by predicting environment state transitions conditioned on current workflow states and candidate operations. We further propose DSWorld, a practical framework that combines structured state construction, cost-aware routing, lightweight real execution, and an LLM-based simulator for expensive operations. To support training, we construct an 8K-scale transition trajectory dataset and introduce Reflective World Model Optimization, an error-aware reinforcement learning strategy for improving transition prediction. Experiments show that DSWorld accelerates RL-based agent training by approximately $14\times$ and search-based inference by approximately $3$-$6\times$ while maintaining competitive performance, and outperforms the strongest LLM baseline by 35.6% on transition prediction tasks. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DSWorld.
2607.15901.paper_summary_zh: 儘管在數據理解和決策制定方面具有強大的能力，自主數據科學代理仍然在很大程度上依賴於涉及昂貴計算的試錯工作流程。這一瓶頸促使我們提出能夠在實際執行之前預測數據科學操作效果的模型。在本文中，我們介紹了數據科學世界模型的概念，該模型通過預測基於當前工作流程狀態和候選操作的環境狀態轉變來建模數據科學執行環境。我們進一步提出了DSWorld，一個實用框架，結合了結構化狀態構建、成本感知路由、輕量級實際執行和基於LLM的昂貴操作模擬器。為了支持訓練，我們構建了一個8K規模的轉換軌跡數據集，並引入了反思世界模型優化，一種錯誤感知的強化學習策略，用於改善轉換預測。實驗表明，DSWorld使基於RL的代理訓練加速約$14\times$，基於搜索的推斷加速約$3$-$6\times$，同時保持競爭性能，並在轉換預測任務上超越最強的LLM基準35.6%。代碼可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DSWorld獲得。
